# Extension point reference

Everything the installed modules and core declare, generated from the code. Use it to find the exact names
to depend on (permissions, events, record and task types, slots, triggers). How to use each kind of
extension point is in [api-reference.md](api-reference.md) and [recipes.md](recipes.md).

## Modules

| Module          | Name                              | Depends on          | Description                                                                                                                                |
| --------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `core`          | Core platform                     | —                   | Identity, access control, audit and the module system that every other module builds on.                                                   |
| `alm`           | Applications                      | `cmdb`, `itsm`      | Application inventory, environments, releases and deployments, linked to change management                                                 |
| `announcements` | Announcements                     | —                   | Service notices, maintenance windows and incident updates for everyone.                                                                    |
| `assistant`     | Assistant                         | —                   | An AI agent that customises the platform with change sets people review, apply and roll back                                               |
| `azdo`          | Azure DevOps Server (on-premises) | —                   | Connects the Integrations Hub to a self-hosted Azure DevOps Server collection: team projects, work items and Git repositories.             |
| `cmdb`          | CMDB                              | —                   | Configuration items, how they relate and what an outage would impact                                                                       |
| `dbaccess`      | Database access                   | —                   | Request database roles on SQL Server, Oracle and PostgreSQL: approval, automated provisioning, time-bound access, access reviews and drift |
| `etl`           | Data APIs & ETL                   | —                   | REST endpoints from parameterized SQL and stored procedures, and ETL pipelines between databases                                           |
| `helpdesk-ai`   | Helpdesk AI                       | `itsm`, `knowledge` | AI triage, similar tickets, grounded reply drafts, summaries and the self-service virtual agent.                                           |
| `integrations`  | Integrations                      | —                   | Connections to outside systems, sync rules with field mappings, two-way sync, runs, linked records and conflicts                           |
| `isms`          | Information security              | —                   | Information asset register with C/I/A values, stocktakes, shared accounts and account reviews                                              |
| `itam`          | Assets                            | `cmdb`              | Hardware, software licences, contracts and vendors                                                                                         |
| `itsm`          | Service desk                      | `cmdb`              | Incidents, service requests, problems and changes with SLAs                                                                                |
| `knowledge`     | Knowledge base                    | —                   | Answers and how-to guides for everyone, troubleshooting guides for the service desk.                                                       |
| `projects`      | Projects                          | —                   | Projects, tasks, milestones, boards, timelines and workload                                                                                |
| `scheduler`     | Scheduled jobs                    | —                   | HTTP calls, SQL tasks, sandboxed scripts and module tasks on a schedule, with retries, run history, live logs and alerts                   |
| `sdp`           | ServiceDesk Plus                  | —                   | Connects a self-hosted ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus server to the Integrations Hub: requests, problems, changes, assets and solutions.    |

## Customisation packages

Built-in packages: ready-made sets of changes an administrator installs as one change set (Change sets → From
a package; `manifest.customizationPackages`, content in `defineServerModule({ customizationPackages })`).

| Package               | Name              | Items | Kinds                                                                                             | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| --------------------- | ----------------- | ----- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `isms/isms-processes` | ISMS process pack | 59    | `core.custom-field`, `core.form`, `core.group`, `core.workflow`, `itsm.category`, `scheduler.job` | Request forms, approval workflows and recurring checklists for an ISO 27001-style IT security process set: accounts and access, firewall rules, server room and backup inspections, devices, software, exceptions and incident reports. Creates the groups, service desk categories and scheduled jobs they need. |

## Process actions

What request forms can do after they are sent, approved or rejected (`manifest.processActions`, handlers in
`defineServerModule({ processActions })`). Adding one to a form needs the permission; it runs as the module.

| Action                         | Module      | Name                       | Permission                  | Description                                                                                                                                                                          |
| ------------------------------ | ----------- | -------------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `core.grant-role`              | `core`      | Grant a role               | `core.roles.assign`         | Gives the requester, or a person picked in the form, a role of the platform or of a registered application (VPN, Active Directory, server access), for a number of days or for good. |
| `core.notify`                  | `core`      | Notify people              | `core.forms.manage`         | Sends a notification with your own title and message to the requester, people named in the form, a person or groups.                                                                 |
| `core.webhook`                 | `core`      | Call a webhook             | `core.notifications.manage` | Posts JSON about the request to another system over HTTPS (allowed hosts only), with an optional secret header.                                                                      |
| `core.remind`                  | `core`      | Send a reminder            | `core.forms.manage`         | Reminds people on a date taken from an answer or from a field an approver filled in, a number of days before or after: a rule that expires, short-term use ending, data to wipe.     |
| `cmdb.update-ci`               | `cmdb`      | Update configuration items | `cmdb.cis.manage`           | Sets the status, environment, criticality, support group or custom fields of the CIs picked in the request.                                                                          |
| `isms.register-shared-account` | `isms`      | Register a shared account  | `isms.accounts.manage`      | Registers the approved shared account (or adds the new members to it) with its custodian and the people using it.                                                                    |
| `itam.approve-software`        | `itam`      | Approve software           | `itam.software.manage`      | Add the requested software to the approved software list, or extend the entry that covers it.                                                                                        |
| `itam.assign-asset`            | `itam`      | Assign a device            | `itam.hardware.manage`      | Hand the device picked in the form to the requester or a person picked in the form; the request goes on the device's history.                                                        |
| `itam.return-asset`            | `itam`      | Take back a device         | `itam.hardware.manage`      | Return the device picked in the form to stock or repair, with its condition, the data retention date and the data wipe due date.                                                     |
| `itsm.create-change`           | `itsm`      | Raise a change             | `itsm.changes.manage`       | Raises a change from the request, linked to the CIs it picked, and can submit it to its CAB authorization.                                                                           |
| `itsm.create-ticket`           | `itsm`      | Raise a ticket             | `itsm.config.manage`        | Raises an incident or a service request for the requester, with your title, description, category and group.                                                                         |
| `scheduler.run-job`            | `scheduler` | Run a scheduled job        | `scheduler.jobs.run`        | Runs one of your scheduled jobs now, as if someone pressed "Run now"; the request links to the run.                                                                                  |

## Error codes

Throw `new HttpError(status, ErrorCodes.X, message, details)`. The UI translates by code (`errors.json`).

| Code                          | Message (en)                                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `ACCOUNT_INACTIVE`            | This account is not active. Contact your administrator.                                                                                                                  |
| `ACCOUNT_LOCKED`              | Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.                                                                                                                    |
| `AI_BUDGET_EXCEEDED`          | This month's AI budget has been used up.                                                                                                                                 |
| `AI_NOT_CONFIGURED`           | No AI model is set up yet. An administrator can add one under Administration → AI.                                                                                       |
| `AI_PROVIDER_ERROR`           | The AI service didn't respond. Try again in a moment.                                                                                                                    |
| `ALREADY_GRANTED`             | This person already has this access.                                                                                                                                     |
| `ASSIGNMENT_CLOSED`           | This to-do was already done or cancelled.                                                                                                                                |
| `BAD_REQUEST`                 | The request was not valid.                                                                                                                                               |
| `CHANGE_REQUIRED`             | A production deployment needs an approved change.                                                                                                                        |
| `CHANGE_SET_BUSY`             | Another change set is being applied or tried right now. Try again in a moment.                                                                                           |
| `CHANGE_SET_STALE`            | Someone changed this configuration after the change set was prepared. Refresh the change set, review it again, then retry.                                               |
| `COMMENT_REQUIRED`            | Add a comment to explain your decision.                                                                                                                                  |
| `CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`       | Confirm this action before it runs.                                                                                                                                      |
| `CONFLICT`                    | That conflicts with existing data.                                                                                                                                       |
| `CONFLICT_RESOLVED`           | Someone has already resolved this conflict.                                                                                                                              |
| `CONNECTION_DISABLED`         | That database connection is disabled.                                                                                                                                    |
| `CONNECTION_PURPOSE`          | That database connection can't be used for this.                                                                                                                         |
| `CONNECTION_READ_ONLY`        | That database connection is read-only.                                                                                                                                   |
| `CSRF_INVALID`                | Your session token is out of date. Reload the page and try again.                                                                                                        |
| `DATABASE_ERROR`              | The database returned an error.                                                                                                                                          |
| `DELEGATION_NOT_ALLOWED`      | This approval can't be delegated.                                                                                                                                        |
| `DELIVERY_FAILED`             | The message couldn't be delivered.                                                                                                                                       |
| `DUPLICATE_REQUEST`           | There's already an open request for this access.                                                                                                                         |
| `DURATION_TOO_LONG`           | That's longer than this access can be granted for.                                                                                                                       |
| `EMAIL_NOT_CONFIGURED`        | Email isn't set up yet.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `ENDPOINT_NOT_PUBLISHED`      | This Data API has no published version yet.                                                                                                                              |
| `ENDPOINT_RETIRED`            | This version of the Data API is retired.                                                                                                                                 |
| `FILE_REJECTED`               | That file can't be uploaded.                                                                                                                                             |
| `FILE_TOO_LARGE`              | That file is too large.                                                                                                                                                  |
| `FORBIDDEN`                   | You don't have permission to do that.                                                                                                                                    |
| `FORM_NOT_AVAILABLE`          | This form isn't available right now.                                                                                                                                     |
| `HAS_CHILDREN`                | Move or delete the sub-departments first.                                                                                                                                |
| `INSECURE_HTTP`               | This connection uses plain HTTP, which isn't encrypted. Use HTTPS, or turn on “Allow insecure HTTP” for the connection.                                                  |
| `INTERNAL`                    | Something went wrong on our side.                                                                                                                                        |
| `INVALID_CLIENT`              | The client ID or secret is incorrect, or the client was revoked.                                                                                                         |
| `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`         | Incorrect username or password.                                                                                                                                          |
| `INVALID_DELEGATE`            | That person can't take this approval. Choose someone else.                                                                                                               |
| `INVALID_PARENT`              | A department can't be moved under itself.                                                                                                                                |
| `INVALID_STATE`               | That isn't possible in the current state.                                                                                                                                |
| `INVALID_TRANSITION`          | That status change isn't possible from the current status.                                                                                                               |
| `IN_USE`                      | This is still in use. Remove it from where it's used first.                                                                                                              |
| `JOB_CYCLE`                   | Those dependencies would make the job wait for itself.                                                                                                                   |
| `JOB_RUNNING`                 | The job is running. Wait for it to finish or cancel it first.                                                                                                            |
| `MODULE_DEPENDENCY`           | Other modules depend on this one — change them first.                                                                                                                    |
| `MODULE_DISABLED`             | This module is currently disabled.                                                                                                                                       |
| `NOT_FOUND`                   | That item no longer exists.                                                                                                                                              |
| `NOT_REQUESTABLE`             | This access can't be requested.                                                                                                                                          |
| `NOT_SUPPORTED`               | The connected system doesn't support this.                                                                                                                               |
| `PACKAGE_UNSUPPORTED`         | This package needs modules that aren't enabled or kinds of configuration this platform doesn't have.                                                                     |
| `PASSWORD_MANAGED_EXTERNALLY` | This password is managed by the identity provider.                                                                                                                       |
| `PRINCIPAL_OFFBOARDED`        | This person has been offboarded.                                                                                                                                         |
| `PRINCIPAL_SUSPENDED`         | This person is suspended. Reactivate them first.                                                                                                                         |
| `PRIVILEGE_ESCALATION`        | You can only grant permissions you hold yourself.                                                                                                                        |
| `PROCESS_ACTION_FORBIDDEN`    | You can't add or change this action: it needs a permission you don't have.                                                                                               |
| `PROCESS_ACTION_UNAVAILABLE`  | This action isn't available. Its module may be disabled.                                                                                                                 |
| `RATE_LIMITED`                | You're going a bit fast. Please wait a moment.                                                                                                                           |
| `RELATIONSHIP_INVALID`        | That relationship isn't allowed.                                                                                                                                         |
| `REMOTE_AUTH_FAILED`          | The connected system refused the connection's credentials. Check them in the connection settings.                                                                        |
| `REMOTE_CONFLICT`             | The record changed in the connected system at the same time. It will be compared again.                                                                                  |
| `REMOTE_RATE_LIMITED`         | The connected system is limiting requests. The sync will try again shortly.                                                                                              |
| `REMOTE_REJECTED`             | The connected system refused the change.                                                                                                                                 |
| `RESOLUTION_REQUIRED`         | Describe the resolution first.                                                                                                                                           |
| `REVEAL_EXPIRED`              | This credential was already shown or has expired.                                                                                                                        |
| `REVIEW_CLOSED`               | This access review is closed.                                                                                                                                            |
| `ROLE_HAS_HISTORY`            | People have requested this access before, and that history must be kept, so it can't be deleted. Turn off “People can request this role” and remove its members instead. |
| `SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE`         | Scripts can't run here: no sandbox is configured, or the image isn't allowed.                                                                                            |
| `SCHEDULE_CONFLICT`           | That time window isn't available.                                                                                                                                        |
| `SELF_LOCKOUT`                | That would lock you out of your own account or access.                                                                                                                   |
| `SYNC_RUNNING`                | A sync for this profile is already running.                                                                                                                              |
| `SYSTEM_GROUP`                | System groups can't be changed this way.                                                                                                                                 |
| `SYSTEM_MODULE`               | System modules can't be disabled.                                                                                                                                        |
| `SYSTEM_ROLE_READONLY`        | System roles are managed by their module and can't be changed.                                                                                                           |
| `TARGET_BLOCKED`              | That address isn't allowed.                                                                                                                                              |
| `TASK_NOT_PENDING`            | This approval has already been handled.                                                                                                                                  |
| `TEST_REQUIRED`               | Run a successful test of the current draft before publishing.                                                                                                            |
| `UNAUTHENTICATED`             | Your session has expired. Please sign in again.                                                                                                                          |
| `UPSTREAM_FAILED`             | The remote service couldn't be reached.                                                                                                                                  |
| `VALIDATION_FAILED`           | Some fields need your attention.                                                                                                                                         |
| `WEBHOOK_INVALID`             | The webhook secret is missing or wrong.                                                                                                                                  |
| `WEBHOOK_TARGET_INVALID`      | The webhook URL must use HTTPS and can't point at a private network.                                                                                                     |
| `WORKFLOW_INVALID`            | The workflow has problems that need fixing before it can be published.                                                                                                   |
| `WORKFLOW_NOT_CONFIGURED`     | No approval workflow is set up for this yet. Ask an administrator to publish one.                                                                                        |
| `WRITES_NOT_ALLOWED`          | This SQL changes data. Turn on "Allows writes" to save it.                                                                                                               |

## `core` — Core platform

Identity, access control, audit and the module system that every other module builds on.

### Permissions

| Key                         | Scopes                     | Description                                                                   |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `core.users.read`           | global, department, record | View people and their profiles                                                |
| `core.users.create`         | global, department         | Create people and pre-board new hires                                         |
| `core.users.update`         | global, department, record | Edit people's profiles                                                        |
| `core.users.lifecycle`      | global, department         | Onboard, suspend, reactivate and offboard people                              |
| `core.users.credentials`    | global, department         | Reset passwords of local accounts                                             |
| `core.groups.read`          | global                     | View groups and members                                                       |
| `core.groups.manage`        | global, record             | Create groups and manage membership                                           |
| `core.departments.read`     | global                     | View the organisation hierarchy                                               |
| `core.departments.manage`   | global, department         | Create, move and delete departments                                           |
| `core.roles.read`           | global                     | View roles, permissions and assignments                                       |
| `core.roles.manage`         | global                     | Create and edit custom roles                                                  |
| `core.roles.assign`         | global, department         | Grant and revoke roles                                                        |
| `core.audit.read`           | global                     | Read the audit log                                                            |
| `core.modules.read`         | global                     | View installed modules                                                        |
| `core.modules.manage`       | global                     | Enable, disable and configure modules                                         |
| `core.idp.read`             | global                     | View sign-in providers                                                        |
| `core.idp.manage`           | global                     | Configure sign-in providers and directory sync                                |
| `core.workflows.read`       | global                     | View workflows and running approvals                                          |
| `core.workflows.manage`     | global                     | Design, publish and administer workflows                                      |

### Background jobs

| Job                            | Schedule       | Description                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------ | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `core:ai-reindex`              | every 600 s    | Re-embeds semantic-index documents left on an older embedding model, and re-derives the search terms of chunks made by an older tokenizer |
| `core:check-databases`         | `*/30 * * * *` | Tests every enabled database connection and records its status                                                                            |
| `core:deliver-reminders`       | every 300 s    | Sends the reminders forms scheduled (core.remind) whose date has come                                                                     |
| `core:expire-role-assignments` | every 300 s    | Removes time-bound role assignments once they expire                                                                                      |
| `core:extract-file`            | on demand      | Reads an attachment for search (text layer, Office files, or the document-extraction service)                                             |
| `core:extract-files-backlog`   | every 900 s    | Queues attachments of indexed records that were never read, and scans to read again once a service is configured                          |
| `core:notify-expiring-access`  | `7 * * * *`    | Tells people a few days before a time-bound role ends                                                                                     |
| `core:process-actions-sweep`   | every 300 s    | Hands process action runs whose job was lost (a worker stopped) to the worker again                                                       |
| `core:purge-files`             | `23 * * * *`   | Deletes the stored bytes of attachments deleted more than an hour ago                                                                     |
| `core:purge-notifications`     | `41 3 * * *`   | Deletes notifications and delivery records older than the retention period                                                                |
| `core:purge-sessions`          | `17 * * * *`   | Deletes sessions that ended more than 7 days ago                                                                                          |
| `core:refresh-sync-schedules`  | on demand      | Re-creates per-provider directory sync schedules after a provider changes                                                                 |
| `core:remind-form-assignments` | `13 * * * *`   | Reminds people of assigned forms due within two days or overdue (at most daily) and tells form editors about overdue ones                 |
| `core:sync-directory`          | on demand      | Synchronises users and mapped groups from an LDAP directory                                                                               |
| `core:workflow-timers`         | every 60 s     | Sends approval reminders and applies SLA breach policies (escalate, auto-decide)                                                          |

## `alm` — Applications

Application inventory, environments, releases and deployments, linked to change management

### Permissions

| Key                        | Scopes | Description                                                      |
| -------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `alm.apps.read`            | global | Browse applications, environments, releases and deployments      |
| `alm.apps.manage`          | global | Create and edit any application, environment and repository      |
| `alm.releases.manage`      | global | Create and edit releases of any application                      |
| `alm.deployments.create`   | global | Record deployments (people and CI/CD API clients)                |
| `alm.deployments.override` | global | Override the change policy for a production deployment (audited) |
| `alm.repositories.sync`    | global | Write repositories and their Git status through integrations     |

### Roles

| Key                   | Name                       | Permissions                                                                      | Everyone |
| --------------------- | -------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- |
| `alm-viewer`          | Applications viewer        | `alm.apps.read`                                                                  | —        |
| `alm-release-manager` | Release manager            | `alm.apps.read` `alm.releases.manage` `alm.deployments.create`                   | —        |
| `alm-pipeline`        | CI/CD pipeline             | `alm.apps.read` `alm.deployments.create`                                         | —        |
| `alm-manager`         | Applications manager       | `alm.apps.read` `alm.apps.manage` `alm.releases.manage` `alm.deployments.create` | —        |
| `alm-admin`           | Applications administrator | `alm.*`                                                                          | —        |

### Events emitted

| Event                              | Payload                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | Description                                                                                               |
| ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `alm.application.created`          | applicationId: string, code: string, name: string, stage: string                                                                                                                                                                                                   | An application was added to the inventory                                                                 |

| `dbaccess:disable-accounts` | on demand                | Disables the accounts of an offboarded person on every server                         |

| `dbaccess:nightly-sync`     | `30 2 * * * Asia/Taipei` | Syncs the inventory of servers with auto sync on                                      |
| `dbaccess:provision`        | on demand                | Creates the account if needed, grants the role and verifies it (retries with backoff) |
| `dbaccess:reviews`          | `15 * * * *`             | Starts scheduled access reviews, reminds reviewers and closes overdue campaigns       |
| `dbaccess:revoke`           | on demand                | Revokes the role of an ending grant and verifies it is gone (retries with backoff)    |

## `scheduler` — Scheduled jobs

HTTP calls, SQL tasks, sandboxed scripts and module tasks on a schedule, with retries, run history, live logs and alerts

### Permissions

| Key                        | Scopes | Description                                                                 |
| -------------------------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `scheduler.jobs.read`      | global | See scheduled jobs, run history, logs and the monitoring dashboard          |
| `scheduler.jobs.create`    | global | Create jobs; edit, run, cancel and delete jobs they own or their group owns |
| `scheduler.jobs.manage`    | global | Edit, enable, disable and delete any job                                    |
| `scheduler.jobs.run`       | global | Run and cancel any job                                                      |
| `scheduler.sql.run`        | global | Create and edit SQL jobs (statements on data connections)                   |
| `scheduler.scripts.manage` | global | Create and edit script jobs (code that runs in the script sandbox)          |

### Roles

| Key                  | Name                         | Permissions                                                        | Everyone |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | -------- |
| `scheduler-viewer`   | Scheduled jobs viewer        | `scheduler.jobs.read`                                              | —        |
| `scheduler-operator` | Scheduled jobs operator      | `scheduler.jobs.read` `scheduler.jobs.create` `scheduler.jobs.run` | —        |
| `scheduler-admin`    | Scheduled jobs administrator | `scheduler.*`                                                      | —        |

### Events emitted

| Event                     | Payload                                                                                          | Description                                                                   |
| ------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `scheduler.job.created`   | jobId: string, name: string, type: string, trigger: string                                       | —                                                                             |
| `scheduler.job.updated`   | jobId: string, name: string, type: string, changes: array                                        | —                                                                             |
| `scheduler.job.deleted`   | jobId: string, name: string, type: string                                                        | —                                                                             |
| `scheduler.job.enabled`   | jobId: string, name: string, type: string                                                        | —                                                                             |
| `scheduler.job.disabled`  | jobId: string, name: string, type: string, automatic: boolean                                    | A job was switched off (by a person, or automatically after a failure streak) |
| `scheduler.run.requested` | runId: string, jobId: string, name: string, trigger: string                                      | Someone ran a job now (or retried a run)                                      |
| `scheduler.run.cancelled` | runId: string, jobId: string, name: string                                                       | —                                                                             |
| `scheduler.run.succeeded` | runId: string, jobId: string, name: string, durationMs: integer\|null, summary: string\|null     | —                                                                             |
| `scheduler.run.failed`    | runId: string, jobId: string, name: string, status: string, error: string\|null, streak: integer | A run failed after its last attempt                                           |

### Events consumed

`core.user.offboarded`

### Record types

### Background jobs

| Job                     | Schedule                 | Description                                                                                                       |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `scheduler:execute-run` | on demand                | Runs one attempt of a job run (retries, timeouts and cancellation are handled by the engine)                      |
| `scheduler:purge`       | `20 3 * * * Asia/Taipei` | Daily: deletes runs and logs older than the retention period (keeps each job’s latest run)                        |
| `scheduler:tick`        | every 30 s               | Every 30 s: starts due scheduled runs, logs missed slots, fails runs whose worker stopped and re-queues lost runs |
